summary: Aspire Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Purchase Agreement to acquire all equity interests and assets of certain FireFish TopCo subsidiaries. Consideration includes at least $30M base purchase price plus $800K for deferred revenue, less tax and indebtedness adjustments. The filing does not disclose premium percentage, board recommendation, or advisors. The deal involves customary representations and is structured as a cash acquisition with Section 1060 asset allocation. Closing is expected after customary conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance and potential purchase price adjustments.
